motivation.r8_negative_pilot: The qualified 13-state A0/A1/A2 pilot completed 312/312 calls with packet invariance and no model drift, but mean U_A0=U_A1=U_A2=0.0961538, mean D=A2-A1=0, mean N=A2-A0=0, and only 3/13 D_i>0. The simple explicit memory-use check therefore did not earn repair actionability.
motivation.remaining_measurement_gap: The frozen 125/172 exposure statistic certifies source-item availability, not consumption or salience of the branch-differentiating residual inside that item.
motivation.review_alignment: The external R7 review explicitly asked that source-item exposure be distinguished from treatment-residual exposure and listed treatment-residual masking/attribution/readout as requiring a separate scientific reopen.

candidate_scientific_question: Does the current source-item exposure measurement overstate effective treatment exposure because success/failure branch-specific residual content is diluted, unaligned, or not separately accessible at the policy surface?
candidate_not_a_repair_claim: This candidate is a measurement/identification extension. It must not be framed as a stronger memory prompt or as a new generic utilization method.

collision_audit.work: Mem2ActBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory Utilization in Task-Oriented Autonomous Agents
collision_audit.overlap: Active memory application to action execution rather than fact recall.
collision_audit.boundary: C1 cannot claim that active use or retrieval-versus-use is new.

collision_audit.work: MemCoRL: Alternating Co-Optimization of Memory Retrieval and Utilization via Collaborative Reinforcement Learning
collision_audit.overlap: Explicit retrieval/utilization separation and utilization optimization.
collision_audit.boundary: A new generic utilization optimizer is outside C1's residual and would collide with published work.

collision_audit.work: Chain-of-Memory: Lightweight Memory Construction with Dynamic Evolution for LLM Agents
collision_audit.overlap: Post-retrieval organization of retrieved evidence into coherent inference paths and pruning of irrelevant context.
collision_audit.boundary: A residual representation cannot simply be relabeled as sophisticated utilization or context pruning.

collision_audit.work: Beyond Retrieval: Query-Conditioned Reuse of Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories
collision_audit.overlap: Keeps candidate retrieval and target state fixed while changing target-bound support delivered after retrieval.
collision_audit.boundary: A target-bound note or reuse-format contribution would collide conceptually even though this is not the selected published-baseline lane.

collision_audit.work: Reliable Post-Retrieval Assembly for Agent Memory: Separating Evidence Extraction from Policy Execution
collision_audit.overlap: Separates evidence extraction from final policy execution after retrieval.
collision_audit.boundary: C1 should not claim generic extraction-versus-execution separation as novel; any residual readout must remain tied to the controlled success/failure treatment contrast.

operationalization_preflight.method: Outcome-blind lexical token-set Jaccard matching between parsed Title/Description/Content items in each success/failure native-wrapper pair, with exhaustive maximum-weight matching over the small item sets.
operationalization_preflight.structural_asymmetry: source task 118 has 3 success items versus 1 failure item

failure_differential.interpretation: The desired scientific object (branch-specific residual access) is meaningful, but the currently available deterministic lexical decomposition is not sufficiently stable to define treatment versus common-core content without introducing a tunable representation choice.

forbidden_actions: Do not select a Jaccard threshold after examining downstream action or terminal outcomes.
Do not search stronger A2 prompt variants on the 13 negative pilot states.
Do not consume the sealed 23-state holdout to tune a residual representation.
Do not use an embedding or LLM semantic matcher and then choose its threshold by downstream effect.
Do not reframe the R8 negative pilot as evidence that post-retrieval utilization is globally impossible.

paper_implication.reason: R8 already supplies a complete diagnosis-to-engineering boundary: stage resolution identifies evidential credit and the surface to interrogate, while the qualified negative pilot shows that this does not automatically identify a successful intervention. An unqualified residual representation would weaken rather than strengthen that story.

reopen_paths.requirement: Qualify a residual representation independently of downstream outcomes, with a pre-frozen semantic or structural matching rule, matched deletion/salience control, and fresh evaluation units.

If broader engineering actionability is still required, formulate a separate carrier study around a published utilization mechanism or benchmark without claiming method novelty, using a new substrate and its own preregistered treatment/control geometry rather than the sealed C1 holdout.

next_smallest_action: Do not execute a new repair experiment. Run the residual-alignment preflight tests, record this HOLD as a reusable representation/operationalization failure asset, and keep R8 as the current manuscript while deciding whether external validation/generalization is more valuable than reopening repair actionability.
